# model.createCurve

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Create a curve.

```lua
model.createCurve()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

the new curve

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local curve = model.createCurve()
curve:name("My Curve")
curve:type(CURVE_TYPE_EXPO)
curve:exp(60)
```
